svg.title: DiveFrame offline world map
svg.description: An equirectangular world map with broad geographic labels for orienting dive markers.
svg.metadata: Source: Natural Earth 5.1.0, ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/v5.1.0/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson). Natural Earth data is public domain (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/). Transformation: GeoJSON country polygons projected from WGS84 longitude and latitude to a 1200 by 600 equirectangular viewBox; coordinates rounded to two decimals. English orientation labels added by DiveFrame.
